recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-12570 in core; changing the formula back to scaleFactor would conflict with the current SampledData element name and FHIR-34191.
issue_request: FHIR-12570 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 clarification requesting an explicit equation showing original measured value[i] = SampledData.data[i] * SampledData.scaleFactor + SampledData.origin.value so implementers would understand origin.value as an offset from the scaled sampled value.
initial_application: The Jira comment records SVN revision 11173, and git-svn commit 17a467b755379116f8ee9b0f489fe66cb93ddfce added the requested equation to source/datatypes.html as '#12570 - add note about SampledData'.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini maps ordinary datatypes to datatypes.html, confirming the checked page is in build scope. The formula now says SampledData.factor rather than SampledData.scaleFactor because later Published issue FHIR-34191 corrected the element name, applied in commit d621ab0bda61832d87d16ee8fa98261bf403a9da. FHIR-50260 is a separate Resolved - change required issue about lowerLimit and upperLimit interpretation and does not affect this origin/factor equation.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because source/datatypes.html already states original measured value[i] = SampledData.data[i] * SampledData.factor + SampledData.origin.value.
